selected_evidence.requirement: All other traffic between lan-a and lan-b is rejected
selected_evidence.summary: Ping and TCP/22 attempts between node2 and node3 return explicit rejections (ICMP Destination Port Unreachable / Connection refused) rather than being allowed, in both directions and after final restart

selected_evidence.requirement: VyOS firewall config applied and matching counters
selected_evidence.summary: show firewall op-mode output confirms rule10 (5432 allow) and rule900 (reject) are hit by real traffic, and persists identically after node1 reboot
